dimensions.label: Accessibility
dimensions.signal: Form labels, hints, error linkage, skip link, and reduced-motion affordances are explicit.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep hover and cinematic states equivalent for touch and keyboard users.

dimensions.label: Motion safety
dimensions.signal: Motion tokens define duration, pressure, fallback, and guarded future 3D behavior.
dimensions.nextAction: Block any mandatory intro until skip and reduced-motion behavior are implemented.

dimensions.label: Mobile performance
dimensions.signal: Canvas particles adapt to viewport, hardware concurrency, and device memory.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep future visual effects opt-in on small screens.

dimensions.label: Content clarity
dimensions.signal: Decision, archive, promotion, motion, and accessibility sections explain why each capability exists.
dimensions.nextAction: Prefer concise system language over dashboard density.

dimensions.label: Repository governance
dimensions.signal: Branch checks, server handoff, polyglot lanes, and iCloud routing are quality-gated.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep commits small and reversible on UIXAppTTR.
